elements_selected.content:
Add --near <PAGE> and --depth <N> flags to the Search subcommand in src/cli.rs:

  --near <PAGE>   Restrict results to pages within --depth hops of PAGE.
                  PAGE is resolved using the same page name resolution as
                  other graph commands (case-insensitive, normalized
                  whitespace/hyphens/underscores). Optional.
  --depth <N>     Neighbourhood radius. Default: 1. Must be >= 1.
                  Only valid when --near is specified.

Validation in cmd_search() (REQ-013-007):
  - --depth without --near → exit code 2, error message.
  - --depth 0 or negative → exit code 2, error message.
  - --near with unresolvable page → exit code 2, suggest similar names (REQ-013-008).

REQ-013-006, REQ-013-007, REQ-013-008, CON-013-001.
